rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their inability to produce a comparable revelation was certain and proved true; they should beware the shirk that earns the Fire.
rows.anchor: وأخبر أنهم قطعا لا يقدرون على ذلك ولا يفعلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Fire is so fierce that even hard stones cannot endure it; frail people have still less capacity to bear it.
rows.anchor: فإذا كانت تلك النار التي لا تثبت لها الحجارة مع صلابتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the believers fear the Fire, its being prepared for disbelievers reassures them; God warns His enemies while giving glad tidings to His friends.
rows.anchor: أعدت للكافرين } ففي ذلك بشارة للمؤمنين . وهذه سنة من الحق سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: False claimants' rebukes recoil into hearts, whereas the truthful person's meaning exerts a conquering force upon hearts; distinguishing these effects is difficult.
rows.anchor: وأمارة المبطل في دعواه رجوع الزجر منه إلى القلوب ، وعلامة الصادق في معناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gardens promise describes deferred blessings granted to believers generally.
rows.anchor: هذه البشارة بالجنان تتضمن تعريفا بنعم مؤجلة لعموم المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the elect, immediate gifts of nearness accompany general deferred reward: proximity, intimacy, communion, inward delight, and unveiling replace outward comfort.
rows.anchor: فتلك المؤجلة جنان المثوبة وهذه جنان القربة ، وتلك رياض النزهة

words: كلما رزقوا منها من ثمرة رزقا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As each heavenly fruit seems like the last until tasted and proves better, realized souls continually ascend, each expected state surpassing the previous one.
rows.anchor: فإذا رقي أحدهم عن محله توهم أن الذي سيلقاه في هذا النفس مثل ما تقدم فإذا ذاقه وجده فوق ذلك بأضعاف

words: كلما رزقوا منها من ثمرة رزقا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites an unnamed poet's image of continually descending through stages of love to illustrate the soul's ever-rising spiritual experience.
rows.anchor: كما قال قائلهم : ما زلت أنزل

words: ما أمر الله به أن يوصل
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A wayfarer who turns back while any money remains is blameworthy; likewise, one seeking God inwardly should not retreat while a breath of life remains.
rows.anchor: ما دام يبقى درهم في كيسه - فغير محمود رجوعه

words: ما أمر الله به أن يوصل
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joining what God commands means connecting oneself to the Real by cutting ties to created things; reversing that order reverses the spiritual result.
rows.anchor: وصل أسباب الحق بقطع أسباب الخلق

words: ما أمر الله به أن يوصل
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The path's people need protection and support through sincere resolve; their aspirations sustain the method while their hearts depend on God's guardianship.
rows.anchor: والإنفاق على تحصيل ذلك بصدق الهمم لا يبذل النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those occupied with peripheral concerns who fail to guide a seeker or strengthen an aspirant corrupt the path and displease God.
rows.anchor: يتشاغلون عن إرشاد مريد بكلامهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A moment in which the secret turns away from witnessing God is itself a breach of the covenant.
rows.anchor: ومن نقض العهد أيضا أن يحيد سرك لحظة عن شهوده

words: وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allowing time to pass in self-directed looking instead of fulfilling God's due severs the commanded connection.
rows.anchor: ومن قطع ما أمرت بوصله أن يتخلل أوقاتك نفس لحظك دون القيام بحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A single hour passing without perceiving God counts as one's corruption on earth.
rows.anchor: ومن فسادك في الأرض ساعة تجري عليك ولم تره فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening is an exclamation of astonishment: with signs made manifest, the heart should not incline toward disbelief.
rows.anchor: هذه كلمة تعجيب وتعظيم لما فيه العبد ، أي لا ينبغي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made Himself known to creatures through the luminous indications and brilliant signs of His power.
rows.anchor: ويقال تعرف إلى الخلق بلوائح دلالاته ، ولوامع آياته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dead are the initially undifferentiated sperm; life differentiates its parts into bone, flesh, hair, skin, and other bodily forms.
rows.anchor: كنتم أمواتا } يعني نطفة ، أجزاؤها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Death reduces people to bones and dust; resurrection gathers them, and return is to the decree already made concerning their felicity or wretchedness.
rows.anchor: ثم يميتكم } بأن يجعلكم عظاما ورفاتا ، { ثم يحييكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In an inward reading, spiritual death is ignorance of God and life is knowing Him; death then means removal from one's own witnessing, followed by revival as God takes one beyond the self.
rows.anchor: بجهلكم عنا ، ثم { فأحياكم } بمعرفتكم بنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This reading makes the return to God the keeping of sacred-law rulings through the enactment of the Real.
rows.anchor: إليه ترجعون } أي بحفظ أحكام الشرع بإجراء الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading calls persistence of the self death and its annihilation life; God then removes the servant from witnessing that state and revives him by taking him from himself.
rows.anchor: لبقاء نفوسكم فأحياكم بفناء نفوسكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant's final return is described as being turned about within God's grasp.
rows.anchor: ثم إليه ترجعون بتقلبكم في قبضته سبحانه وتعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God keeps the realized in alternating states, not permanent life or total annihilation: subsistence and extinction, affirmation and negation, sobriety and effacement succeed one another.
rows.anchor: فهم أبدا بين نفي وإثبات ، وبين بقاء وفناء ، وبين صحو ومحو

words: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God subjected earthly creatures for human benefit: people dwell on earth and under heaven, navigate by stars, and use other creatures; every thing reveals divine power and lordship.
rows.anchor: سخر لهم جميع المخلوقات على معنى حصول انتفاعهم

words: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God also paved the way to experiential knowledge and pointed to His favor, teaching high aspiration by reserving people's works and states for Himself; 41:37 forbids bowing to sun or moon.
rows.anchor: ويقال مهد لهم سبيل العرفان ، ونبههم إلى ما خصهم به من الإحسان

words: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The created realms were ordered by God's power; God Himself did not settle upon a creature or place, impossible for the One beyond spatial delimitation.
rows.anchor: فالأكوان بقدرته استوت ، لا أن الحق سبحانه بذاته - على مخلوق - استوى

words: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةًۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Adam narrative says clay was gathered from every region and left to ferment for forty mornings; the angels wondered what its destiny would be, then marveled at his fashioned form.
rows.anchor: أمر حتى سل من كل بقعة طينة ثم أمر بأن يخمر طينه أربعين صباحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's announcement about Adam disclosed a secret and divided the angels' conjectures, despite their wonder at the artistry and wisdom of his form.
rows.anchor: فحين قال : { إني جاعل في الأرض } ترجمت الظنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Among created things, Adam alone receives this explicit announcement; its wording would resemble consultation from a creature, but here it honors and singles him out.
rows.anchor: خلق الجنان بما فيها ، والعرش بما هو عليه من انتظام الأجزاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites an unnamed poet saying that among the many beauties seen, the speaker's choice fell upon the beloved, illustrating Adam's special selection.
rows.anchor: عليك من الورى وقع اختياري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels' question is inquiry, not objection to God's decree; Qushayri prefers the reading that preserves their immunity from sin.
rows.anchor: فإن حمل الخطاب على ما يوجب تنزيه الملائكة أولى لأنهم معصومون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ransoming captives while expelling them from their homes violates another obligation; fulfilling one duty does not excuse failing the rest.
rows.anchor: فكذلك يفترض عليكم كف أيديكم عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who accepts part of what is commanded and rejects the rest forfeits the reward for the good he neglected.
rows.anchor: من فرق بين ما أمر به فآمن ببعض وكفر ببعض فقط حبط - بما ضيعه - أجر ما عمله

words: فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They imagine their actions benefit them, but discover that deeds mixed with defects and stripped of sincerity are not accepted.
rows.anchor: فانكشف لهم في الآخرة أن جميع ما فعلوه - لما مزجوه بالآفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A captive sunk in desire is freed by being shown the path of guidance.
rows.anchor: فمن أسير غرق في بحار الهوى فإنقاذه بأن تدله على الهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A captive of whispering doubts is freed by guidance to certainty through proofs, away from suspicion and blind imitation.
rows.anchor: ومن أسير بقي في أيدي الوساوس فافتداؤه أن ترشده إلى اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A captive of self-promptings is freed by being directed to witness divine favors and cease attributing power to creatures.
rows.anchor: فك أسره بأن تدله على شهود المنن ، بتبريه عن حسبان كل حول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One imprisoned in his own self is freed by being urged to depart from it and helped to restrain himself.
rows.anchor: ففك أسره إنشاده إلى إقلاعه ، وإنجاده على ارتداعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A captive in created attributes is freed by being guided to the Real through the bonds of created existence.
rows.anchor: ومن أسير تجده في أسر صفاته ففك أسره أن تدله على الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For one already held by God, there is no ransom, return, release, way back, alternative comfort, or reversal of the divine decree.
rows.anchor: ليس لأسرائهم فداء ، ولا لقتلاهم عود ، ولا لربيطهم خلاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who prefer something over God lose in both worlds; he supports the warning with a poem about those who turned away and became self-sufficient.
rows.anchor: إن الذين آثروا عليه شيئا خسروا في الدنيا والآخرة كما قالوا : أناس أعرضوا عنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent a succession of messengers, all calling to the One; people listened through desire, accepting what pleased their souls and denying what their appetites disliked.
rows.anchor: أوصلنا لهم الخطاب ، وأردفنا رسولا بعد رسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people make their own desire their defining attribute and object of worship, the worshiped object takes on the worshiper's qualities, bringing woe upon them.
rows.anchor: فإذا كان الهوى صفتهم ثم عبدوه ، صارت للمعبود صفات العابد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People who display resolve for battle may collapse when danger arrives; sincerity to God would make them steadfast, as 47:21 says.
rows.anchor: انهدم عند التفات الصفوف ، وانجزل عن الجملة خشية هجوم المحذور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Envy lowered them from honor to disgrace; refusing the judgment earned them a fresh rebuke in addition to the one already deserved.
rows.anchor: أنزلهم التحاسد عن مقر العز إلى حضيض الخزي ، وسامهم ذل الصغر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asked to prove their apparent agreement through actual spiritual state, they accepted only what suited desire and denied what exceeded their interests, excluding themselves from the elect.
rows.anchor: إذا قيل لهم حققوا ما أظهرتم من حكم الوفاق بتحقيق الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although called to pure oneness, they worshiped what suited their lower nature, including the calf; its removal left traces in hearts and descendants, explaining Jewish anthropomorphism.
rows.anchor: أي دعاكم إلى التوحيد ، وإفراد المعبود عن كل معبود ومحدود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeated reports of calf-worship and rejection show that neither counsel nor punishment stopped their sins; they ignored blame and failed to obey.
rows.anchor: كرر الإخبار عن غلوهم في حب العجل ، ونبوهم عن قبول الحق

words: ولن يتمنوه أبدا بما قدمت أيديهم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Longing for death in safety signals longing for Paradise; their refusal to wish for it, foretold by God, confirmed the Prophet, while believers who yearn for death are promised forgiveness and Paradise.
rows.anchor: وأخبر الله سبحانه أنهم لن يتمنوه أبدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Love of worldly life reflects heedlessness of God; those most heedless cling hardest to remaining here, while the believer's condition is the opposite.
rows.anchor: حب الحياة في الدنيا نتيجة الغفلة عن الله ، وأشد منه غفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heedless and libertine cling to life because they know how much obedience they missed; like a runaway slave, they do not want to return to their master.
rows.anchor: فالعبد الآبق لا يريد رجوعا إلى سيده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For believers, returning to the One whose good is hoped for is better than remaining with one whose harm is feared; a long life cannot forestall sudden death, and every coming event is near.
rows.anchor: وكل ما هو آت فقريب ، وإذا انقضت المدة فلا مرد لهجوم الأجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Completing pilgrimage rites signifies fulfilling the body's duty of servanthood; remembering God like one's fathers signifies the heart's duty of love, sustained throughout life.
rows.anchor: قضيتم مناسككم } إشارة إلى القيام بحق العبودية .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since people take pride in their ancestors, the faithful should take pride and joy in God; His claim and favors exceed those of their forebears.
rows.anchor: ويقال كما أن الأغيار يفتخرون بآبائهم ، ويستبشرون بأسلافهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Parents have a claim through upbringing, but God's claim is greater and His favors more complete; His majesty exceeds ancestors' good qualities.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن كان لآبائكم عليكم حق التربية فحقنا عليكم أوجب ، وأفضالنا عليكم أتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As one does not tire of remembering one's father, one should persist in remembering God without weariness, boredom, or forgetfulness.
rows.anchor: ويقال إنك لا تمل ذكر أبيك ولا تنساه على غالب أحوالك ، فاستدم ذكرنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as one resists attacks on one's lineage, one should defend God against the claims of people of error and innovation.
rows.anchor: إن طعن في نسبك طاعن لم ترض فكذلك ما تسمع من أقاويل أهل الضلال والبدع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remember God with reverent awe and gentle intimacy; fathers are remembered respectfully, mothers compassionately, while God shows mercy and is not an object of mercy.
rows.anchor: الأب يذكر بالحرمة والحشمة فكذلك اذكرنا بالهيبة مع ذكر لطيف القربة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse names fathers rather than mothers because fathers are remembered with reverence, whereas mothers are remembered with compassion.
rows.anchor: وقال { كذكركم آباءكم } ولم يقل أمهاتكم لأن الأب يذكر احتراما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God deserves more remembrance than fathers, and a knower may feel estranged from a father but cannot conceive of God failing what is due.
rows.anchor: لأن الحق أحق ، ولأنك قد تستوحش كثيرا عن أبيك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A father is remembered according to what he merits, and the Lord according to what He merits.
rows.anchor: الأب علىما يستحقه والرب على ما يستحقه

words: فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A creature would count such a request as gratitude, yet God graciously permits people to bring complaints to Him; some hearts still settle for their worldly share.
rows.anchor: فقال : من الناس من لا يجنح قلبه إلينا ، ويرضى بدوننا عنا

words: وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَٰقٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worldly good that gathers every good is preservation of faith through death; the afterlife good that gathers all good is forgiveness.
rows.anchor: والحسنة التي بها تحصل جميع الحسنات في الدنيا - حفظ الإيمان عليهم في المآل

words: فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading calls the world's good renunciation of it and the next world's good protection from settling in it; refuge from the Fire includes the flames of separation and burning longing.
rows.anchor: ويقال الحسنة في الدنيا العزوف عنها ، والحسنة في الآخرة الصون عن مساكنتها

words: أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people reproached Mary, God made Jesus speak on his first day; he presented signs including raising the dead, healing the blind and leper, and revealing their secret deeds.
rows.anchor: أنطق الله عيسى عليه السلام وهو ابن يوم

words: وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus confirmed earlier revealed laws while receiving a law that abrogated some earlier rulings and retained others, as the Qur'an specifies.
rows.anchor: وأخبر أنه مصدق لما تقدمه من الشرائع ، ومختص بشريعة تنسخ بعض ما تقدمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most people rejected Jesus while some believed; knowing prophecy brings trials and enemies, he turned his heart from them toward God and sought helpers for devotion.
rows.anchor: علم أن النبوة لا تنفك عن البلاء وتسليط الأعداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those marked by divine care and special selection answered that they were God's helpers, affirmed belief, and asked Jesus to witness their sincerity.
rows.anchor: نحن أنصار الله ، آمنا بالله ، واشهد علينا بالصدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The remaining opponents intensified hostility and scheming; God made them taste its consequence, while their belief that they killed Jesus was ignorance and confusion.
rows.anchor: فجدوا في الشقاق ، وبالغوا في العداوة

words: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raised Jesus, His prophet and friend, while his enemies earned expulsion and curse; God's counterplot overcame them.
rows.anchor: فالله - سبحانه - رفع عيسى عليه السلام نبيه ووليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward reading, taking Jesus means taking him away from himself and raising him beyond human attributes and personal will until God's directing governs him.
rows.anchor: الإشارة فيه إني متوفيك عنك ، وقابضك منك ، ورافعك من نعوت البشرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus' miracles appeared in this surrender because those events came about only through divine power.
rows.anchor: حتى تكون مصرفا بنا لنا ، ولا يكون عليك من اختيارك شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further reading says God purified Jesus' heart from attending to otherness and witnessing likenesses and traces in every state.
rows.anchor: ويقال طهر قلبه عن مطالعة الأغيار ، ومشاهدة الأمثال والآثار

words: وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus' followers are those who kept his religion and monotheistic creed; they remain right and receive victory, force, and proof until the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: ومتبعوه من لم يبدل دينه ومن هو على عقيدته في التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the Resurrection God judges Jesus' opponents and followers: disbelievers enter the Fire and believers enter bliss.
rows.anchor: ثم إن الله سبحانه يحكم - يوم القيامة - بينه وبين أعدائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revealed account teaches Muhammad its meanings by revelation, not by requiring him to acquire them through analogy or inference.
rows.anchor: نعرفك معانيه بما نوحي إليك ، لا بتكلفك ما تصل إلى علمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Servanthood means embracing God's commands and avoiding what He forbids.
rows.anchor: العبودية معانقة الأمر ومفارقة الزجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Open association is belief in another deity; hidden association notices any existent besides God. Unity recognizes that every event exists through God, its maker, originator, and sustainer, with no creaturely share in creation.
rows.anchor: الشرك جليه اعتقاد معبود سواه ، وخفيه : ملاحظة موجود سواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Subtle ostentation, flattery, self-admiration, acting for people's gaze, savoring their praise, and shrinking under criticism are all hidden shirk.
rows.anchor: دقائق الرياء وخفايا المصانعات وكوامن الإعجاب والعمل على رؤية الخلق ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sequence begins with parents because they are one's kind and raised one; their rights are the first step toward further growth and realization of knowledge.
rows.anchor: أمرت أولا بحقوقهما لأنهما من جنسك ومنها تربيتك ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being fit for companionship with relatives, the poor, orphans, and their peers is a stage toward becoming worthy of companionship with God.
rows.anchor: إذا صلحت للصحبة والعشرة مع ذوي القربى والفقراء والمساكين واليتامى ومن في طبقتهم -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since a house neighbor deserves kindness, one must not neglect the heart, the neighbor of the self, or allow corrupt thoughts to settle there.
rows.anchor: فجار نفسك - وهو قلبك - أولى بألا تضيعه ولا تغفل عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit is the heart's neighbor and deserves protection from incompatible occupants; the secret is the spirit's neighbor and must be guarded from absence from witnessing.
rows.anchor: فجار قلبك - وهو روحك - أولى أن تحامي على حقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that God is with people wherever they are has an unmistakable inward indication to realized hearts.
rows.anchor: الإشارة منه غير ملتبسة على قلوب ذوي التحقيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In outward legal language, miserliness means withholding what is obligatory; inwardly, it means refusing altruism in a time of need.
rows.anchor: البخل على لسان العلم منع الواجب ، وعلى بيان الإشارة ترك الإيثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Urging miserliness inwardly means discouraging seekers from spiritual realities under the guise of legal compassion, warning them against hardship, begging, or burdening Muslims.
rows.anchor: منعهم عن مطالبات الحقائق في معرض الشفقة عليهم بموجب الشرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If advisers were not inwardly stingy, they would strengthen an aspirant instead of blocking him; extinguishing a weak seeker's desire earns immediate displeasure.
rows.anchor: فلولا بخله المستكن في قلبه لأعانه بهمته فيما يسنح لقلبه بدل أن يمنع عنه

words: وَيَكْتُمُونَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wealthy may conceal God's bounty while seeking an increase without permission; alternatively, one may withhold lifesaving guidance when a seeker asks.
rows.anchor: إن كان الله أغناهم عن طلب الفضيلة بما خولهم وآتاهم كتموا ذلك طمعا في الزيادة

words: وَيَكْتُمُونَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He distinguishes the wealthy person's stinginess in withholding material bounty from the poor person's stinginess in withholding spiritual aspiration.
rows.anchor: بخل الأغنياء بمنع النعمة ، وبخل الفقراء بمنع الهمة

words: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ مُخْتَالًۭا فَخُورًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their immediate punishment is exclusion from the company of God's beloved, which is itself a sufficient trial.
rows.anchor: فعقوبتهم في العاجل أنهم ليسوا من جملة محبيه ، وكفى بذلك محنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The conceited person looks at himself, while the show-off looks at other people; both bear the mark of hidden shirk.
rows.anchor: والمختال الذي ينظر غلى نفسه والمرائي الذي ينظر إلى أبناء جنسه ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fakhūr is likened to a camel or ewe whose udder is tied to exaggerate its milk; likewise, a pretender displays false spiritual rank and a show-off spends to be seen.
rows.anchor: والفخور من الإبل كالمصراة من الغنم وهو الذي سدت أخلافه ليجتمع فيها الدر

words: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger's duty is to convey the message; realizing connection through divine existence and state belongs to God's power and eternal will.
rows.anchor: يعني قل لهم إنما على تبليغ الرسالة ، فأما تحقيق الوصلة بالوجود والحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not join those disputing God's signs or answer expansively; turn away graciously and do not listen to their incoherent talk.
rows.anchor: لا توافقهم في الحالة ، ولا ترد عليهم ببسط القالة . ذرهم ووحشتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If forgetfulness occurs, recover through remembrance and alertness, then avoid repeating the mistake and suffering painful punishment.
rows.anchor: فتداركته بحسن التذكر وجميل التنبه ، فاجتهد ألا ( تزل )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those unstained by wrongdoing will be kept apart on Resurrection Day from the pains prepared for wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: أي من كان نقي ( الثوب ) عن ارتكاب الإجرام يعزل يوم نشره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has prepared hidden stratagems that will break wrongdoers' veil of delusion and hardness when He brings them upon them.
rows.anchor: فإنا أعتدنا لهم ( من خفي المكر ما إذا أحللناه بهم كسرنا عليهم ) خمار الوهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When disbelievers invite Muslims back to shirk, guidance and clear proof cannot rationally be traded for error or Paradise abandoned for Hell.
rows.anchor: أنؤثر الضلال على الهدى بعد طلوع شمس البرهان ؟ وندع الطريقة المثلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Someone delivered from Satan's companions and able to see their error would not follow them back into their company.
rows.anchor: وكيف يساعد أتباع الشيطان من وجد الخلاص من صحبتهم ، وأبصر الغي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The realized should remain in intimate communion; a tongue accustomed to whispering with the Sovereign will not turn to address the lowly.
rows.anchor: أمرنا بملازمة محل المناجاة لأن اللسان إن تعود نجوى السلطان

words: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No newly arising purpose can obstruct God's power, and His judgment does not fall short in governing any existent thing.
rows.anchor: لا يعترض على قدرته - سبحانه - حدوث مقصود ، ولا يتقاصر حكمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage contrasts an origin marked by denial with descendants marked by monotheism, affirming that God acts as He wills.
rows.anchor: الأصل متهم في الجحود ، والنسل متصف بالتوحيد ،

words: إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's prior care and later guidance showed Abraham proofs of unity until his inner secret was clear of doubt; he then renounced all others.
rows.anchor: لاطفه بسابق العناية ، ثم كاشفه بلاحق الهداية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading shows Abraham passing from star-like intellect and proof, to moon-like knowledge and evidence, then to sun-like gnosis, where doubt and concealment vanish.
rows.anchor: فطلع نجم العقول فشاهد الحق بسره بنور البرهان ، فقال : هذا ربي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the dawn of realization came and the suns of gnosis rose, no room remained for seeking, possibility, or suspicion, so Abraham disavowed what his people associated.
rows.anchor: فلم يبق للطلب مكان ، ولا للتجويز حكم ، ولا للتهمة قرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative reading has Abraham first see created signs through God, then see things as belonging to and coming from God, and finally behold them effaced in God.
rows.anchor: كان يلاحظ الآثار والأغيار بالله ، ثم كان يرى الأشياء لله ومن الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham directs his purpose to God, purifies his creed, keeps his covenant for God, and devotes his yearning to Him until he is effaced in God.
rows.anchor: أفردت قصدي لله ، وطهرت عقدي عن غير الله ، وحفظت عهدي في الله لله
